diagnostics.message: The form input of formJsonText holds a file at file inside the field meta, but a file is a top-level field.
diagnostics.fix: Make the file a top-level field of a multipart input (inputMedia: multipart), or return it as a download.

diagnostics.message: The form input of formFile holds the file field file, but a form body carries no file.
diagnostics.fix: Set inputMedia: multipart, which carries files.

diagnostics.message: The file field file of tooLarge allows 2097152 bytes, more than the route's body limit of 1048576 bytes.
diagnostics.fix: Raise bodyLimit on the route, or lower the file's maxSize.

diagnostics.message: The form input of formScalar is not an object schema, so it has no fields.

diagnostics.message: The field anything of the form input of formOpaque has no form encoding.
diagnostics.fix: Give the field a number, boolean, text, list or object schema, a file in multipart, or JSON text (contentMediaType: application/json).
